-- 1. Create Dimension Tables
CREATE TABLE DimCustomer (
    CustomerKey INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    CustomerID NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    CustomerName NVARCHAR(100),
    Region NVARCHAR(50),
    Segment NVARCHAR(50)
);

CREATE TABLE DimProduct (
    ProductKey INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    ProductCode NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    ProductName NVARCHAR(100)
);

CREATE TABLE DimDate (
    DateKey INT NOT NULL,
    FullDate DATE NOT NULL,
    Year INT,
    Month INT,
    Day INT
);

-- 2. Create Fact Table
CREATE TABLE FactSales (
    SaleID NVARCHAR(50),
    CustomerKey INT,
    ProductKey INT,
    DateKey INT,
    Quantity INT,
    UnitPrice DECIMAL(18,2),
    TotalPrice DECIMAL(18,2)
);

-- 3. Load Dimension: DimCustomer
INSERT INTO DimCustomer (CustomerID, CustomerName, Region, Segment)
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID, CustomerName, Region, Segment
FROM Stg_Customers;

-- 4. Load Dimension: DimProduct
INSERT INTO DimProduct (ProductCode, ProductName)
SELECT DISTINCT ProductCode, 'Product ' + ProductCode
FROM Stg_Sales;

-- 5. Load Dimension: DimDate (Derived from Sales)
INSERT INTO DimDate (DateKey, FullDate, Year, Month, Day)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    CAST(FORMAT(OrderDate, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT),
    OrderDate,
    YEAR(OrderDate),
    MONTH(OrderDate),
    DAY(OrderDate)
FROM Stg_Sales;

-- 6. Load Fact Table: FactSales
INSERT INTO FactSales (SaleID, CustomerKey, ProductKey, DateKey, Quantity, UnitPrice, TotalPrice)
SELECT 
    s.SaleID,
    c.CustomerKey,
    p.ProductKey,
    CAST(FORMAT(s.OrderDate, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT),
    s.Quantity,
    s.UnitPrice,
    (s.Quantity * s.UnitPrice)
FROM Stg_Sales s
JOIN DimCustomer c ON s.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN DimProduct p ON s.ProductCode = p.ProductCode;
